name: SemilatticeSup
sup_le
result.signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [self : SemilatticeSup α] (a b c : α), a ≤ c → b ≤ c → SemilatticeSup.sup a b ≤ c
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [self : SemilatticeSup α] (a b c : α), a ≤ c → b ≤ c → SemilatticeSup.sup a b ≤ c
result.informal_name: Supremum is Less Than or Equal to Common Upper Bound in a Sup-Semilattice
result.informal_description: For all elements $a, b, c$ in a sup-semilattice, if $a \leq c$ and $b \leq c$, then $a \sqcup b \leq c$.

name: sup_le
result.signature: : a ≤ c → b ≤ c → a ⊔ b ≤ c
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {a b c : α}, a ≤ c → b ≤ c → a ⊔ b ≤ c
result.informal_name: Supremum is Less Than or Equal to Common Upper Bound
result.informal_description: If $a \leq c$ and $b \leq c$, then the supremum $a \sqcup b$ satisfies $a \sqcup b \leq c$.

name: sup_le_iff
result.signature: : a ⊔ b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ c ∧ b ≤ c
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {a b c : α}, a ⊔ b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ c ∧ b ≤ c
result.value:
:=
  ⟨fun h : a ⊔ b ≤ c => ⟨le_trans le_sup_left h, le_trans le_sup_right h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => sup_le h₁ h₂⟩
result.informal_name: Supremum Less Than or Equal iff Both Elements are Less Than or Equal
result.informal_description: For all elements $a$, $b$, and $c$, the supremum of $a$ and $b$ is less than or equal to $c$ if and only if both $a$ and $b$ are less than or equal to $c$. In symbols, $a \vee b \leq c \leftrightarrow a \leq c \land b \leq c$.

name: sup_lt_iff
result.signature: : b ⊔ c < a ↔ b < a ∧ c < a
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b c : α}, max b c < a ↔ b < a ∧ c < a
result.value:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨le_sup_left.trans_lt h, le_sup_right.trans_lt h⟩, fun h => sup_ind (p := (· < a)) b c h.1 h.2⟩
result.informal_name: Supremum Less Than iff Both Elements Less Than
result.informal_description: For any elements $a$, $b$, and $c$ in a lattice, $b \sqcup c < a$ if and only if $b < a$ and $c < a$.

name: le_inf
result.signature: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {c a b : α}, c ≤ a → c ≤ b → c ≤ a ⊓ b
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {c a b : α}, c ≤ a → c ≤ b → c ≤ a ⊓ b
result.informal_name: Infimum is the Greatest Lower Bound
result.informal_description: For any elements $a$, $b$, and $c$ in a semilattice infimum, if $c \leq a$ and $c \leq b$, then $c \leq a \sqcap b$.
